answers.genPolicy:92691f7ae3d0d9862c2aac6a8894e2:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .

[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .

[B3] < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' cloudA | (deviceB ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ cloudA 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (deviceB ; list(encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'share' ; UserY)) .

[B4] < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , Rest) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' cloudA | (deviceB ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ cloudA 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (deviceB ; list(encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY)) .

[B5] < ImmediateRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ cloudA 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (deviceB ; L)
=> < ImmediateRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' deviceB | L .

[B6] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (deviceB ; L)
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : L , ... > .

[B7] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : L , ... >
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > $ CachingRelayUser 'forwardCommand' deviceB | L
if L =/= nils .

[B8] < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , ... > < deviceB | 'trusted' : Trusted , ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' deviceB | list(encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'share' ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , ... > < deviceB | 'trusted' : (UserY , Trusted) , ... > .

[B9] < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , ... > < deviceB | 'trusted' : (UserY , Rest) , ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' deviceB | list(encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , ... > < deviceB | 'trusted' : Rest , ... > .
